summary: Structural wall sections, design criteria, material notes, connections, and special-inspection notes are shown. Preliminary observations are limited to a potentially conflicting concrete-code edition reference, differing soil-pressure values that require engineering reconciliation, and drafting/title-block clarifications.

drafts.title: Concrete reference identifies an older ACI edition
drafts.observation: The sheet’s Design Data states “INTERNATIONAL BUILDING CODE (IBC 2015),” while the Reinforced Concrete notes state “ALL CONCRETE WORK SHALL CONFORM TO ACI 318-06 CODE REQUIREMENTS.” The relationship between the adopted 2015 IBC concrete provisions and the older ACI edition is not explained on this sheet.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Design Data item 1 reads “INTERNATIONAL BUILDING CODE (IBC 2015).” Reinforced Concrete note 1 reads “ALL CONCRETE WORK SHALL CONFORM TO ACI 318-06 CODE REQUIREMENTS.”
drafts.drawing_location: Right-side Structural Notes panel; Design Data and Reinforced Concrete sections.
drafts.suggested_code_reference: 2015 IBC base code — concrete provisions; precise section and referenced concrete-standard edition require verification.
drafts.recommendation: Have the structural engineer confirm the governing concrete design standard and revise the note if ACI 318-06 is not the intended standard for the 2015 IBC-based permit design.

drafts.title: Soil bearing values require reconciliation
drafts.observation: The Masonry and Foundation Notes identify an “ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL” of 1,500 PSF, while a later note identifies “DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF” at the bottom of the footing depth. The sheet does not identify different soil conditions or explain how these two values are to be used for the same foundation design.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Masonry and Foundation note 1 reads “ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL IS 1,500 PSF.” Masonry and Foundation note 8 includes “DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF, TO BOTTOM OF FOOTING DEPTH SHOWN ON DRAWINGS.”
drafts.drawing_location: Right-side Structural Notes panel, Masonry and Foundation Notes section, notes 1 and 8.
drafts.recommendation: Have the geotechnical and structural design documents identify the governing allowable bearing pressure, applicable soil condition, and whether the 1,500 PSF and 2,500 PSF values represent different design cases. Revise the notes or provide supporting calculations as appropriate.

drafts.title: Wall Section 2 scale notation is malformed
drafts.observation: The scale label for Wall Section 2 is printed as “SCALE: 3/4"1'-0"” without the equals sign shown in the Wall Section 1 scale notation.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Wall Section 1 is labeled “SCALE: 3/4"=1'-0"”; Wall Section 2 is labeled “SCALE: 3/4"1'-0".”
drafts.drawing_location: Bottom detail-title bands beneath Wall Sections 1 and 2.
drafts.recommendation: Correct the Wall Section 2 scale notation to clearly state the intended scale, or identify it as not to scale if that is the design intent.

drafts.title: Sheet-count field appears incomplete
drafts.observation: The title block’s sheet field visibly reads “AS NOTED OF 00,” which does not identify a recognizable current-sheet/total-sheet count.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Title block field reads “SCALE: AS NOTED” and “SHEET: OF 00.”
drafts.recommendation: Confirm and complete the sheet-number and total-sheet fields in the title block so the permit set can be unambiguously indexed.
